thread:
zendesk-bot: New ticket created: #5642 — Customer: BlueCurrents. Subject: Procurement requires PO before invoicing.
maya-support: Heads-up — Zendesk #5642 from BlueCurrents. Procurement won't allow AP to pay unless a PO number is on the invoice. They want to start next week but say AP will not accept invoices without PO match.
maya-support: Quick facts: Dedicated plan, expected first invoice ~ $12k/mo. Sales says SOW was signed on 2025-10-02. Customer procurement contact provided: j.sanchez@bluecurrents.com.
liam-csm: Thanks Maya. Do we have copy of the signed SOW in CLM? Any PO clause in the contract?
maya-support: CLM shows signed SOW and signature page. No explicit "mandatory-PO-before-invoice" clause that I can see, but customer insists their internal policy requires a PO for AP match.
tom-billing: In Finance, standard is: if customer requires PO for payment, we usually wait for PO before issuing invoice. Exceptions possible with Sales+CS written approval.
priya-legal: From Legal: if the SOW/contract governs payment terms, invoicing could proceed. However, if customer policy means they will not process invoice without PO then invoicing now may lead to non-payment. We should avoid forcing a mismatch.
raj-sales: Sales is OK to approve a one-month provisional billing waiver so deployment isn't blocked. Condition: customer must provide written intent to issue PO within 30 days and billing details (PO#, remit-to, VAT ID).
maya-support: Customer asked whether we can invoice now and they will provide PO later (retroactive PO). They say AP system will only pay invoices that include a PO number.
tom-billing: Finance doesn't accept retroactive PO numbers as standard practice. However we can: 1) create a pro-forma invoice for provisioning (not sent to AP), 2) hold final invoice until PO received, or 3) escalate for an exception if Sales signs off on credit risk.
liam-csm: I'll ask the customer for a written acceptance: email from their procurement saying they'll send PO by X date and accept invoicing terms. Also request: PO number (when available), billing contact, remit-to address, VAT/tax info.
maya-support: Customer responded with a draft PO template and estimated ETA: 10 business days. Pasted their draft (sanitized):
```
BlueCurrents Purchase Order
PO#: TBD
Requested By: J. Sanchez
Billing Addr: Accounts Payable, BlueCurrents, 200 Harbor Rd
VAT ID: 814-XX-999
ETA: 2025-11-07
```

tom-billing: Good. Finance will provision access if Sales signs the waiver AND CSM confirms the PO-ETA email. I'll create a pro-forma labeled 'Provision only — final invoice upon receipt of PO' and hold it in accounting (ticket FIN-7892).
priya-legal: Legal OK with that flow. Add a short clause to the waiver email: 'Customer will provide PO within 30 days; Redwood may issue a final invoice reflecting the PO number and make adjustments if needed.'
raj-sales: Confirmed — Sales approves the one-month waiver contingent on the written PO-ETA. Raj here will back the credit risk.
maya-support: Action items:
- @liam-csm: capture customer's PO-ETA email and billing details.
- @raj-sales: provide sign-off email for waiver.
- @tom-billing: create pro-forma and hold (FIN-7892).
- @priya-legal: prepare a short clause for the waiver.

tom-billing: I'll add FIN-7892 to our queue and tag @maya-support and @liam-csm. Setting invoice status = hold-for-PO.
liam-csm: I'll post the customer's confirming email here once I have it — ETA tomorrow EOD.
maya-support: Perfect. For audit trail, pls paste the customer's email thread (we'll attach to FIN-7892).
maya-support: One more note — if PO is delayed beyond 30 days, we should reassess (billing, risk, whether to invoice and escalate collections).
raj-sales: Agreed. We'll monitor.
maya-support: Thanks all — closing this Slack thread for now; will reopen when CSM posts the PO email. :white_check_mark:
